message.content: {"caption":"Four-panel line chart of complexity and diversity metrics across training steps.","description":"Four side-by-side line plots share an x-axis labeled “Training Steps,” with ticks at 0, 80, 160, and 240. The first two plots are grouped under “Complexity”; the last two are grouped under “Diversity.” Each plot has one colored line and a y-axis starting at 0: blue “ComplexiPy Score” (top tick 0.47), green “Halstead Measure” (top tick 0.20), red “AST Edit Distance” (top tick 0.78), and orange “Answer Diversity” (top tick 0.99). ComplexiPy Score rises unevenly, reaches a broad high region, spikes to near the top of its scale around 210 training steps, then plunges and settles near 0.20. Halstead Measure rises overall with several dips and sharp oscillations late in training, including a deep dip followed by a peak near 0.20; it ends below that peak. AST Edit Distance rises rapidly to a high plateau, declines somewhat, spikes to the top of its scale near 240 steps, then falls. Answer Diversity rises rapidly from near zero to about 0.96 by around 60 steps and then stays nearly level, with small fluctuations near 0.99. There are no arrows, checks, or crosses.
